g.text: do / cumin sends the merge (also while cumin stops)
: cumin starts an agent. Before every start, cumin decides from the quota usage.
At a limit, cumin starts nothing, changes no label for that start, and counts nothing;
the issue keeps its state, and a later poll decides again.
Gray: cumin starts no agent (a label, a comment, a notification, a close). Dashed: a Maintainer acts.
While cumin stops after the current runs (cumin stop --after-current-runs):
cumin takes no red transition; the issue keeps its state until the next start.
cumin still takes the gray transitions, and still sends a merge.
